title: Fold a column away
summary: Collapse a column to its heading to make room on the board, and open it again when you need it.
benefit: Keep a long list together without it taking over the board.
outcome: A collapsed column shows only its title and how many cards it holds. Opening it brings the same cards back in the same order.

sections.title: Collapse and expand a column
paragraphs: Collapsing hides a column's cards. It doesn't delete them or take them out of the column. For example, fold away a Kit checklist while you compare walking routes in the column next to it.

flow.entry: Find the arrow at the left of the column's heading.

steps.action: Click the arrow at the left of the heading (Collapse column).
steps.result: The cards slide away. The heading stays, with the title and a count such as 4 cards.
The column takes up only its heading, so the cards nearby have room. You can still drag the column by its heading.
The same cards come back in the same order.

flow.completion: On a board you can edit, the column stays collapsed or expanded for everyone, including after a reload.
flow.correction: Undo reverses a collapse or an expand. You can also click the arrow again.

figures.alt: Two columns side by side. Routes to try is open and shows three route notes. Kit checklist is collapsed to its heading, with a right-pointing arrow and the count 4 cards.
figures.caption: Kit checklist is collapsed to its heading and card count. Routes to try is still open.

sections.title: Find a card in a collapsed column

flow.entry: Open Fetch, DoggyNote's search, from the magnifying glass in the top bar, or press ⌘K (Ctrl+K on Windows).

steps.action: Type a word from the card, for example towel.
steps.result: Matching cards appear with the board they're on.

steps.action: Choose the result, or use the arrow keys and press Enter.
steps.result: DoggyNote opens that board, expands the column and selects the card.

flow.completion: The column stays open so you can keep working in it.
flow.correction: Click the column's arrow to collapse it again, or press Escape to close Fetch without going anywhere.

sections.title: The count and connections
paragraphs: The count includes every card directly inside the column. A board card counts as one, however much is inside that board. Cards in Buried bones, DoggyNote's bin, aren't counted.
A line connected to a card inside a collapsed column ends at the column's heading and is drawn dashed. Expand the column and the line goes back to its card.

sections.title: View-only boards and exports
paragraphs: On a board shared with you as view only, you can still collapse and expand columns to look around. That only changes your own view; everyone else sees the board as its owner left it.
Export PNG in the board's … menu shows columns as they are on screen. Expand a column first if you want its cards in the picture.
